site_description: What Foundry VTT packages declare, for tools that work out what to install.
home_lede: What Foundry VTT, its game systems and its modules declare in their manifests, gathered from Foundry VTT's package listing, GitHub and GitLab, for tools that work out which versions can be installed together.
endpoint_lookup_summary: A set of packages, everything they need, and how fresh each is.
endpoint_listing_summary: Every package Foundry VTT's listing offers.
endpoint_recheck_summary: Packages' own manifests, checked again now.
machine_translation_notice: This page was translated by machine and the translation has not been reviewed. If something is unclear, the English version is authoritative.
error_other: Something went wrong on our side. Please try again later.
sign_in_lede: Sign in to the Mondarth catalogue with an account you already have.
sign_in_stores: Signing in stores your name, email address and picture from the provider you choose, and the address and browser you sign in from.
sign_in_none: Signing in is not available at the moment.
sign_in_failed: Signing in did not work. Please try again.
profile_handle_hint: Given to you at random when your profile was made. It is shown wherever you have set no nickname.
nickname_hint: 3 to 32 letters, digits, spaces, hyphens or underscores, shown in place of your user id. Leave it empty to be shown by your user id.
nickname_problem_length: A nickname is 3 to 32 characters long.
nickname_problem_characters: A nickname has only letters, digits, spaces, hyphens and underscores.
nickname_problem_reserved: That nickname is kept for the site's own use.
delete_explanation: This removes your profile, the providers you sign in with and every session, all at once. It cannot be undone.
delete_confirm: I understand that this cannot be undone
delete_unconfirmed: Tick the box to confirm that you want your profile deleted.
delete_stale: For your safety, sign out and sign in again before deleting your profile: you signed in more than a day ago.
privacy_lede: Signing in to the catalogue stores what this page lists, and nothing else about you. We do not sell it, share it, or use it for advertising.
privacy_from_provider: The provider you sign in with
privacy_name_why: Shown on your profile page, to you alone.
privacy_email_what: Your email address, and whether the provider checked it
privacy_email_why: One profile for each email address. In future, to write to you about a subscription, if you take one.
privacy_picture_why: Shown on your profile page. Only its address is stored, not the picture.
privacy_handle_what: Your user id, such as amber-falcon-ridge-42
privacy_handle_why: Your name on the site until you set a nickname.
privacy_nickname_what: Your nickname, if you set one
privacy_account_what: Which provider you sign in with, and its id for your account
privacy_account_why: Recognising you when you sign in again.
privacy_tokens_what: The provider's tokens for your account, and when they expire
privacy_tokens_why: Kept, encrypted, as the provider gave them when you signed in. The catalogue does not use them to read anything more from your account.
privacy_session_what: Your sessions, and when each ends
privacy_session_why: Keeping you signed in: for 30 days, renewed while you use the site, or until you sign out.
privacy_device_what: The address and browser each session was signed in from
privacy_device_why: Seeing where your account is signed in, to help spot misuse. The address is also used, but not kept, to limit how often anyone can try to sign in.
privacy_pending_why: Checking that a provider's answer is to a sign-in started here. It is kept until the sign-in finishes; one never finished expires after 10 minutes.
privacy_times_what: When each of these was made and last changed
privacy_kept: Until you delete your profile, from your profile page, which removes all of it at once. A session ends when it expires or you sign out.
privacy_cookies: One cookie keeps you signed in, and short-lived ones hold a sign-in while it is in progress. Another keeps the language you chose.
impersonation_banner: You are viewing the site as {name}. What you change is recorded as yours.
admin_search_hint: By user id, nickname, name or email address.
admin_configured: An admin as ADMIN_USER_IDS names them: their role and ban are changed only by the deployment.
admin_self: This is you: what an admin does to others is not offered on yourself.
admin_ban_reason: Reason, shown to them when they try to sign in (optional)
admin_ban_days: For how many days (leave empty for until unbanned)
admin_ban_reason_too_long: The reason may be at most 200 characters.
admin_impersonate_hint: For an hour at most, or until you stop. Everything you change meanwhile is recorded as yours, done as them.
admin_refused_impersonating: Not while you are viewing the site as someone: stop first.
admin_refused_configured: This admin is named in ADMIN_USER_IDS: only the deployment changes their role or ban.
admin_refused_admin: You may not view the site as another admin.
admin_audit_lede: What admins have done, and what anyone did while an admin viewed the site as them, the newest first.
audit_action_user_impersonate: Began viewing the site as them
audit_action_user_stop_impersonating: Stopped viewing the site as them
delete_impersonating: A profile cannot be deleted while an admin is viewing the site as its user.
privacy_role_why: What you may do on the site. Only an admin changes it.
privacy_ban_what: Whether an admin has banned you, why, and until when
privacy_ban_why: Stopping misuse: a banned profile cannot sign in. The reason is shown to you when you try.
privacy_impersonation_what: Which admin, if any, is viewing the site as you in a session
privacy_impersonation_why: An admin may view the site as you for up to an hour, to help with a problem you ask about. Such a session is marked, and everything done in it is recorded as the admin's.
privacy_audit_what: A record of what admins did: who, as whom, what, to which user id, when, and what changed
privacy_audit_why: Holding admins to account. When you delete your profile, the record keeps only that something was done to your user id, and when; what it held of you, such as your nickname, is removed.
sign_in_banned: This profile is banned, and cannot sign in.
sign_in_banned_forever: Your profile is banned, until an admin lifts the ban.
subscription_admin: As an admin, you have everything a subscription gives, subscribed or not.
subscription_gives: A subscription is needed for what the catalogue and EMMA offer subscribers.
subscription_how_both: You can subscribe by linking your Patreon (with a suitable pledge) or by purchasing time directly.
subscription_how_patreon: You can subscribe by linking your Patreon (with a suitable pledge).
subscription_how_buy: You can subscribe by purchasing time directly.
subscription_offers_none: Subscriptions are not on sale yet.
subscription_buy_soon: Buying a subscription here is coming soon. Meanwhile, an admin can grant you one.
subscription_price_before_tax: {price} + applicable tax (VAT or sales tax), worked out at checkout
subscription_buy_consent: I ask that my time be activated as soon as I pay, and I agree to the Terms and Conditions.
subscription_buy_needs_consent: The Terms and Conditions must be accepted to buy: tick the box above.
subscription_buy_how: You pay on Stripe's checkout page. Stripe, through Onelink, is the merchant of record: it works out and charges any tax where you live, and emails your receipt and invoice. The final amount, in your own currency, is shown there before you pay.
subscription_buy_cancel: You may cancel a purchase within 14 days and be refunded for the time not yet used, and ask for a refund of your remaining time at any time after.
subscription_buy_problem_consent: Tick the box to ask that your time be activated as soon as you pay, and to agree to the Terms and Conditions, before you buy.
subscription_buy_problem_offer: That offer is no longer on sale.
subscription_buy_problem_stripe: Stripe could not start the checkout, and nothing was charged: try again later.
subscription_buy_problem_impersonating: Nothing can be bought while viewing the site as someone else.
subscription_checkout_done: Thank you. Your time is added once Stripe confirms the payment, usually within a minute: reload this page to see it.
subscription_checkout_cancelled: You left the checkout, and nothing was charged.
subscription_checkout_processing: A payment of yours is still being confirmed: its time is added when it is.
subscription_refund_ask: Cancel and ask for a refund
subscription_refund_ask_named: Cancel the purchase of {date}, {period}, and ask for a refund
subscription_refund_done: We have received your cancellation. We refund the time not yet used, counted from when that time starts, usually within a few days; Onelink emails you when it is made, and the time it refunds is then taken off your subscription.
subscription_refund_problem_credit: That purchase cannot be refunded here: it is refunded already, or was not paid for. If you think this is wrong, write to us.
admin_grant_hint: Added after the subscription's end, or from now if it has ended.
admin_set_end_hint: At the start of the day, UTC. A later day adds time; an earlier one cuts every credit back to it.
admin_problem_period: Give whole months and days: at least one day, and at most ten years.
admin_problem_note: The note may be at most 200 characters.
admin_offers_lede: What a subscription is bought by. An offer is never changed once made: to change a price or period, make a new offer and retire the old one. The shortest offer on sale is the least that can be bought.
admin_offer_name: Name, as it is offered, such as 12 months
admin_offer_prices: Prices, one a line, such as GBP 30.00
admin_offer_problem_name: Give a name, of at most 80 characters.
admin_offer_problem_prices: Not a price: “{line}”. Give a currency's code and an amount, one a line, such as GBP 30.00.
admin_offer_problem_dates: The offer must go off sale after it goes on.
admin_offer_problem_stripe: Stripe could not make the offer, so none was made: try again later.
admin_refunds_none: No refund is waiting to be made.
admin_refunds_lede: Make each in Stripe's dashboard, for the amount suggested: the time not yet used, counted from when the purchase's own time starts. Once Stripe says it is made, its time is taken off the subscription, and it leaves this list.
admin_offer_stripe_hint: An offer with a price in {currency} is made a Stripe product, and sold through Stripe at that price before tax.
privacy_subscription_what: Your subscription's time: each span, when it was bought or granted, from and until when, where it came from (granted by an admin, Patreon or a payment), its period, and, for one an admin granted, who and their note
privacy_subscription_why: Knowing whether you are subscribed, and until when. Deleting your profile deletes it.
privacy_checkout_what: For each purchase you begin: the offer, the payment provider and its reference for the checkout, how it stands (open, being paid, paid, failed or expired), when you asked that your time be activated and agreed to the Terms and Conditions, and the time it bought
privacy_checkout_why: Knowing what you agreed to, and when, as the terms of sale require, and matching what the payment provider says of a payment to your purchase. Deleting your profile deletes it.
privacy_payment_what: For a payment: which payment provider took it, what it was paid with (such as a card), the provider's reference for it, the total paid, tax included, in the currency paid, how much of it has been refunded and when, when you asked for a refund, and whether it was disputed with your bank and how that stands
privacy_payment_why: Matching a payment to the time it bought, showing you what you paid for it, taking back the time a refund or a chargeback paid for, and finding it with the provider if you ask about it. No card numbers, names or addresses are kept: the provider keeps the invoice.
admin_problem_ban_days: Give a whole number of days, at most 3660 (ten years), or leave it empty for a ban until lifted.
endpoint_me_summary: Who a user's token is for, and their subscription.
endpoint_callers_module: A key, the EMMA module's among them, or a subscriber's token.
endpoint_callers_full: A key that is not a module's, or a subscriber's token.
endpoint_callers_user: A user's token, subscribed or not.
developers_auth: Every request says who is asking: an API key, in the X-API-Key header, or a signed-in user's token, as Authorization: Bearer <token>. A user's token reaches every endpoint while they are subscribed; without a subscription the API answers subscription-required, saying when it ended.
device_sign_in_first: A device asks to use your catalogue account. Sign in to see which, and to approve it.
device_confirm: {client} asks to use your catalogue account, on the device that shows this code:
device_check: Check it is the code the device shows, and approve only a device you are using yourself. It stays signed in for 30 days, and for 30 more each day it is used, until you sign it out from your profile.
device_approved: Approved. You can close this tab and go back to the device.
device_denied: Denied. The device is not signed in.
device_expired: This code has expired. Ask the device for a new one.
device_unknown: No device is waiting with this code. Check it, or ask the device for a new one.
device_already: This code has been approved or denied already.
device_impersonating: A device cannot be approved while an admin is viewing the site as someone.
devices_lede: Where your account is signed in. Signing one out ends it at once.
devices_impersonation: An admin viewing the site as you
privacy_client_what: For a session a device signed in, such as EMMA's browser extension, which client it is
privacy_client_why: Saying, in your list of signed-in devices, what each session is, so that you can sign one out.
privacy_device_sign_in_what: A device signing in: the codes it and you are given, whether you approved it, and when the codes expire
privacy_device_sign_in_why: Letting a device, such as EMMA's browser extension, sign in to your account once you approve it on this site. Kept until the codes expire, ten minutes on.
subscription_patreon_intro: Patrons of the catalogue on Patreon pledging {amount} or more are subscribed for as long as they pledge: link your Patreon account to be subscribed through your pledge. Patreon is asked again once a day.
subscription_patreon_intro_unset: Patrons of the catalogue on Patreon will be subscribed while they pledge, once the admins set the least pledge.
subscription_patreon_below: Your pledge, {amount}, is less than the {minimum} that subscribes.
subscription_patreon_no_minimum: You are a patron, but the least pledge that subscribes is not set yet.
subscription_patreon_declined: Patreon declined your last payment, so your pledge does not subscribe you until it is paid.
subscription_patreon_former: You are no longer a patron, so Patreon does not subscribe you.
subscription_patreon_not_member: Your Patreon account is linked, but is not a patron of the catalogue.
subscription_patreon_relink: Patreon no longer lets the catalogue see your pledge: link your Patreon again.
subscription_patreon_never: Patreon has not answered yet: ask it again shortly.
subscription_patreon_unreachable: Patreon could not be asked just now. What it last said still counts for up to three days.
subscription_patreon_error_taken: That Patreon account is linked to another profile already.
subscription_patreon_error_failed: Your Patreon could not be linked. Try again.
subscription_patreon_error_only: Patreon is the only way you sign in, so it cannot be unlinked. Link another way to sign in first, from your profile.
subscription_patreon_error_refused: That could not be done just now.
admin_done_patreon: The least Patreon pledge is saved.
admin_patreon_unset: No least pledge is set, so Patreon subscribes no one.
admin_patreon_set: Patrons pledging {amount} or more are subscribed.
admin_patreon_hint: A currency's code and an amount, in the campaign's currency, such as GBP 5.00. Leave it empty to subscribe no one by Patreon. It counts at once.
admin_patreon_problem: Give one currency's code and an amount, such as GBP 5.00, or leave it empty.
audit_action_payment_refund: Took back a refunded payment's time
admin_patreon_does_not: They have Patreon linked, which does not subscribe them.
admin_patreon_said: Patreon said: {status}, pledging {amount} (minor units), as of {checked}.
privacy_patreon_what: If you link Patreon: whether you are a patron of the catalogue's campaign, what you pledge, when Patreon next charges you, and when it was last asked, and whether it answered
privacy_patreon_why: Knowing whether your pledge subscribes you. Patreon is asked again once a day; unlinking Patreon, or deleting your profile, deletes it.
privacy_payments: The catalogue keeps minimal payment details: for each payment, only the processor's own reference for it and the total paid, never a card, account or address. A Patreon pledge is not kept here: it is asked of Patreon, with your permission, when you link it.
privacy_invoices: Invoice details may be maintained by payment processors for legal compliance: each processor keeps its invoices, and what it needs to make them, under its own privacy policy, as below.
privacy_processor_patreon_what: your Patreon account, your pledges and their payments, for your membership of the catalogue's campaign and its billing.
privacy_processor_stripe_what: your payments for subscription time, your billing address and payment details, and the receipts and invoices it sends you, as the merchant of record.
